reuse.why: Replaces the five inline midpoint copies (schedule-template, forecast, updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule, preview) with the existing getScheduledAmount helper and reuses getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: After the change the expected-amount rule exists once; the per-site null/number/range dispatch is gone from every server site.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts, used by server, API model and client alike; the API model only maps the helper's result.

scope.why: Edits serve the five steps; the API type is widened through a new APIScheduleListItem type, a reasonable but extra surface.

maintainability.why: A single, small helper with an explicit op parameter; inserting op before inverse changes the positional signature and the useScheduleEdit callers still call it without op.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All planning/posting/preview sites go through getScheduledAmount.

disguised_duplication.where: None; the copies are removed rather than reshaped.

abstraction_drift.where: getScheduledAmount gains the op parameter that the approximate rule needs; no special-case branches or bypassing sites remain.
